info.name: WTH-Task-Tracker
info.description:
This API allows developers to integrate and manage authentication, task tracking, user roles, and reporting features for our project management system. It provides secure JWT-based authentication, robust access control, and a flexible task management module with progress tracking, attachments, and reporting.

The API is REST-based and built with **Node.js**, **Express**, and **MongoDB**. It supports both **member** and **admin** roles to ensure proper permission control.

request.description:
Creates a new user account by accepting a name, email, and password.

If successful, the endpoint returns a JWT token that can be used to authenticate future requests. Duplicate email addresses are not allowed.

Authenticates an existing user by validating email and password credentials.

Returns a signed JWT token on success, which is used for accessing protected resources.
Fetches the profile of the currently logged-in user based on the token provided in the Authorization header.

item.description:
The Authentication endpoints handle user account creation, login, profile management, and role-based access control.

These endpoints use **JWT (Bearer tokens)** to protect private routes and ensure only authenticated users can access sensitive resources.

**Key Features:**

- Secure JWT-based login and registration.
    
- Fetching authenticated user details.
    
- Admin-only user invitation.

item.name: Tasks
item.description:
The Task endpoints manage task creation, assignment, updates, and progress tracking.

Each task can have a title, description, due date, priority, checklist, attachments, and assigned users.

Admins can view all tasks, while regular members can only view and update their assigned tasks.

**Key Features:**

- Create, view, update, and delete tasks.
    
- Assign tasks to users or groups.
    
- Track progress and checklist items.
    
- File attachments and due date management.
    
- Admin visibility into all tasks.
